 --> Asian Paints Q2 net profit rises 7.5% to Rs 1,068 cr, revenue jumps 17%; margins shrink amid raw material inflation
 Asian Paints Q2 FY27 Financial Results: Asian Paints Q2 net profit rose 7.5 percent to Rs 1,067.6 crore, while revenue jumped 16.9 percent. Margins contracted amid raw material inflation, prompting further price increases. Shares fell nearly 2 percent. 
 Shaleen Agrawal
